speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have symptoms of jaundice, itching, weight loss, pale stools, and dark urine; these signs suggest a problem with bile flow or liver function. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any pain in the upper right side of your abdomen, or any changes in your appetite or digestion?

text: 72-year-old male. The patient has experienced gradual yellow discoloration of the skin and generalized pruritus over the past 2 weeks.
